name: RoofGS Range-Aware Fast Exponential Evaluation
definition: A fast bit-level approximation of the exponential function used to replace the transcendental exp() operation in the Gaussian blending loop, leveraging the bounded range of the exponent.
summary: RoofGS Range-Aware Fast Exponential Evaluation replaces transcendental exponentials with a range-aware bit-level approximation to reduce SFU pressure and boost throughput in Gaussian Splatting.
